name: Skill Request Law (Part 1) (Testing)
description:
Below is a list of chat commands the user can use to put in a request for specific skill scrolls. The user is limited to 3 requests per day and the book for that scroll must be crafted to allow the request. This does not guarantee the user will beable to buy that scroll, only that they allowed the MoE know theres a demand for it.

Commands are:
!request Carpentry
!request Shipwright
!request Composites
!request Papermilling
!request Advanced Baking
!request Advanced Cooking
!request Baking
!request Cooking
!request Basic Engineering
!request Electronics
!request Industry
!request Mechanics
!request Farming
!request Fertilizer
!request Milling
!request Butchery
!request Masonry
!request Pottery
!request Advanced Masonry
!request Glassworking
!request Oil Drilling
!request Blacksmith
!request Smelting
!request Advanced Smelting
!request Tailoring
!request Painting

Author: Kyokes

properties.Title: Carpentry Skill Scroll Request Command
properties.UserDescription: Typing !request carpentry will let the MoE know there is an active request for the skill scroll.
